title: Make standard s-test-command pass
body: Outcome: `krn standards check --record s-test-command` no longer fails s-test-command.

Why: adoption found this floor standard failing: exit 1 from if [ -s package.json ]; then node -e 'const t=(JSON.parse(require("fs").readFileSync("package.json","utf8")).scripts||{}).test||"";process.exit(t.tr...
